fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name this server advertises. Must resolve to this server's public IP.

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use '127.0.0.1' for loopback-only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

port.description: NNTP service port. Standard unencrypted NNTP port is 119.

nntps_enabled.description: Enable NNTPS (NNTP over TLS/SSL) service on a dedicated port.

nntps_port.description: Port for NNTPS (NNTP over TLS). Standard port is 563.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_articles.description: Maximum number of articles to retain per newsgroup (0 = keep all).

max_age.description: Maximum age of articles in days (0 = keep forever). Older articles are expired.

spool_directory.description: Directory where NNTP articles and metadata are stored.

config_directory.description: Directory for configuration files (e.g., active, newsgroups).

interactive.description: Enable interactive mode (used for batch article imports or maintenance tasks).

server.description: Enable serving of articles to clients (required for NNTP server mode).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to syslog.

peers.description: List of upstream NNTP peers to fetch articles from.

allow_read.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets allowed to read articles (subscribe, fetch, etc.).

allow_post.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets allowed to post articles to this server.

default_group.description: Default newsgroup to show when user visits root newsgroup list (optional).

debian_config_path.description: Path to Debian-specific config file sourced by cron scripts.

touch_groups_file.description: Path to file listing newsgroups to touch (mark as read).

failed_postings_dir.description: Directory where failed postings are queued for retry.
